claim: Independent Synthetic Provider and infrastructure bill lines reconcile one exact billing period to settled C19 ledger meters and remain within frozen absolute and basis-point thresholds.

actualGapAndRemediation.priorGap: The prior costVarianceReport only summarized supplier cost already embedded in the internal ledger; it had no independent bill input, exact threshold binding, or unmatched-line failure path.
remediation: Add an independent closed Synthetic Provider and infrastructure bill input.
Bind exact immutable thresholds in both the bill fixture and reconciliation code.
Require one-to-one meter and dimension mapping and fail closed on either unmatched side.
Verify absolute supplier variance, absolute booked variance and booked basis-point variance.

limitations: This supplement does not change any D1 work-package or Gate state.
The fixed bill set is independent Synthetic test input, not an ERP invoice, Provider bill, cloud bill or enterprise accounting record.
No scheduled ingestion, production Connector, threshold approval, alert delivery or accounting write-back is claimed.
The reconciliation function consumes the public C19 cost report seam; PostgreSQL regression verifies that source report but does not represent a live billing integration.
The exact source and test artifacts are Git-frozen; this receipt does not represent a live billing integration or production financial control.
